hooks.prompt: You are finishing a build brief in the AdveroSolutions revenue automation repo. Check the transcript: did this brief (1) run its tests or a --dry-run on fixtures/live read-only data, (2) write Job_Log entries or a shadow log, and (3) write or update its runbook under 'Agentic Worklfows/runbooks/' or 'Agentic Worklfows/directives/'? If any of the three is missing and the brief was a build task, answer that the agent should continue and name the missing item. If this was a conversational turn, a question, or a pause requested by the user, let it stop.
